scope: Exact aggregate terminal metadata plus a diagnostic summary. Full captured inputs and raw streams are retained in local execution records; this public record is not their byte-for-byte projection.
diagnostic_summary: The numerical-PDF self-test accepted fixture omitted all three mandatory historical Markdown files. Each produced cannot read preserved historical Markdown; the accepted exact-mode control failed before the PDF comparison.
root_cause: The production Markdown checker inspects the repository-visible Markdown set and mandatory historical paths. The isolated fixture copied the checker but omitted its newly required archive inputs.
successor: Copy the exact direct archive files into every fixture; preserve custody enforcement and add missing/drift controls in both modes.
